find_odd_occurrence: find the number occurring an odd number of times in an array using f_gold
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample arrays to verify it returns the odd-occurring number
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use XOR or a hash map for better time complexity
review_f_gold: review f_gold brute-force approach that counts occurrences for each element in the array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the element with an odd occurrence count in an array
